scoring_justification: The headline quantities are the final minimized energies, gap, and condensation energy. The checker cannot recompute the full numerical minimization; it compares the agent's reported scalars to the paper's reference values using threshold-or-better for energies and exact-match tolerances for gap/condensation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for ground-state energies, superconducting gap, and condensation energy for square and simple cubic lattices.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper's text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published numerical results of the paper, traceable to the specified equations.

outputs.description: Computed optimal variational parameters and ground-state properties for the square lattice. The checker compares each numeric column against hidden reference values; energies are scored on a threshold-or-better basis, gap and condensation energy on exact match within tolerance.

Computed optimal variational parameters and ground-state properties for the simple cubic lattice. The checker compares each numeric column against hidden reference values; energies are scored on a threshold-or-better basis, gap and condensation energy on exact match within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each column to hidden reference values derived from the paper's reported results. The optimal τ and β are sanity-checked but not directly scored.
